title: JP Cahn's $10,000 offer to Scully

tellings.quote: He approached Scully and offered him $10,000 for the rights to [music] the story, but Scully refused.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells how around 1950 in San Francisco, a man named J.P. Cahn approached Frank Scully, a writer whose story was about crashed flying saucers and alien bodies. According to Michels, Cahn offered Scully $10,000 for the rights to the story, and Scully turned him down. Michels tells it as part of the history of an early claim that alien bodies had been recovered.
